builder.scope:
MustFix repair required:

F3: Produce the reproducible visual evidence gallery (12+ screens from DESIGN_BRIEF) as actual audit artifacts (screen captures/images). The current V2-05-visual-evidence.test.ts only performs structural data assertions (e.g. expect(score.balances.length).toBe(2)) and does NOT produce any image artifacts. DESIGN_BRIEF 'Galerie de reference obligatoire' and QUALITY_GATES QG-4 require at least 12 reproducible screen captures kept as audit artifacts.

Approach: Create a deterministic screen capture pipeline. Options include:
1. Use Expo web export (npx expo export --platform web) to produce a web bundle, then use a headless browser (puppeteer/playwright) to capture each screen state as a PNG image.
2. Create a React Native Storybook setup that renders each screen state in isolation and captures static screenshots.
3. Create a dedicated render script that programmatically renders each screen component with fixed props/data and uses react-native-view-shot or a web-based renderer to produce PNG artifacts.

The gallery must include at minimum: connexion, racine foyers, Ajouter Premium, Ajouter Free + archive, Score Premium, Score Free, To-do Premium, mini-form complétion, To-do Free, upsell historique, Options, share card, plus empty/error states. Each image must be reproducible from the accepted tree (deterministic data, deterministic render).
